content: WCAG 2.2 SC 1.4.1 (Level A): color must not be the only visual means of conveying information. WAI G14: also provide the information in text. Heatmaps need persistent numeric labels on cells, not color-only and not tooltip-only. Adjacent graphical steps should meet ~3:1 non-text contrast (1.4.11); text on keys must meet 1.4.3. Sequential single-hue lightness scales survive grayscale/CVD better than rainbow or red-green.
